name: Lila Hawthorne
location: Urban food district of Veridian City
observable_traits: Carries a small notebook and pen
capabilities: Has the power to impact restaurant revenue
goals: Ensuring diners receive authentic culinary experiences
boundaries: Refuses to endorse overly processed foods
Avoids conflicts of interest with restaurant owners

relationships.description: Competes professionally but respects each other's craft
Frequent critics who sometimes debate their reviews

history_notes: Started her career after a disappointing dining experience
Known for a controversial review that closed a beloved eatery
current_state: Conducting a tasting at a newly opened gastropub, scrutinizing every dish for quality and ethics
facts_they_know: Believes that food integrity is paramount to culinary art
Recognizes the impact of her reviews on restaurant success
beliefs: Overly processed foods compromise the dining experience
She has the moral obligation to protect diners from subpar offerings
factual_errors: She mistakenly believes that all restaurants can improve their offerings with better reviews
